title: A little of everything
description: Soft horizontal stacks show absolute contributions and direct totals on a common zero baseline.

props.name: data
props.description: Unique nonempty IDs, labels and nonnegative values keyed by series ID. Any missing or invalid part, or overflowing total, makes the whole row unavailable. Zero retains a total without a mark.

props.name: series
props.description: Ordered series with unique nonempty IDs, labels and optional tones a–d. Reordering retains identity colors.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned measurement label; defaults to Value (Units for SoftGauge).

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats readings and tooltips; defaults to en-US numbers with at most two decimals.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense categorical plots scroll locally when the supplied size cannot hold their data.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
